name: materio
description: Materio - all in one place for all your study needs. read, discuss, contribute

scripts.build: bundle exec jekyll build && netlify build
scripts.minify-js: uglifyjs assets/scripts/auth.js assets/scripts/login.js assets/scripts/signup.js assets/scripts/forgot-password.js assets/scripts/profile-management.js -o _site/assets/scripts/auth.min.js --source-map --compress --mangle
scripts.optimize: npm run minify-js && npm run copy-min
